title: GTA6 PC Port Rumoured to Arrive in Record Time After PS5 Launch
description: A new report suggests that GTA 6 might break Rockstar Games' traditional long wait times, bringing the highly anticipated PC version as early as Q1 2027.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Will GTA 6 Break Tradition with a Rapid PC Release?

Rockstar Games has long been known for prioritising console platforms for its major video game releases. Historically, PC versions of massive open-world titles like Grand Theft Auto V and Red Dead Redemption 2 have followed many months, or even years, after their initial console debuts. This staggered release strategy has forced PC enthusiasts to endure lengthy waiting periods while console players enjoyed the games first.

However, a fresh report indicates that the highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto 6 might defy this longstanding pattern, delivering the PC port in record time following its initial appearance on current-generation hardware.

## A Q1 2027 Window for PC Gamers?

According to a report from GamesBeat cited by Push Square, GTA 6 is currently expected to arrive on PC in the first quarter of 2027. This projected timeframe points to a gap of just a few months following the game's initial launch on the PlayStation 5.

It is important to emphasize that this information originates from unverified reporting and speculation rather than an official announcement from Rockstar Games. The developer has not formally detailed its post-launch schedule or confirmed a specific PC release window. Therefore, players should view this timeline with cautious optimism until concrete official details emerge.

## Editor's Take

If this rumor turns out to be accurate, it would represent a significant shift in Rockstar's traditional strategy, reflecting the growing importance of the PC market. However, until the developers make an official statement, this remains an unconfirmed report, and fans should temper their expectations.
